reconcile.note: Henry identifies Thaddaeus/Lebbaeus with Judas the brother of James and the Canaanite with Simon the Zealot, treating both as name variants of the same men.

discrepancy.note: Strauss notes the four apostle catalogues share a common structure but disagree on names in the concluding quaternion.

quotes.text: We have in the New Testament four catalogues of the apostles; one in each of the synoptical gospels, and one in the Acts … but the intermediate members are differently arranged, and in the concluding quaternions there is a difference of names or of persons.
quotes.attr: David Friedrich Strauss (d. 1874), The Life of Jesus Critically Examined, trans. George Eliot (1846), §74, on Matthew 10:2-4 and Luke 6:14-16.

sides.snippet: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
